name: stock.start

description.en: Start stock (W-STOCK P1): the sushi starter pack (41 supplies with unit, kind, category, nutrition and loss defaults, names in sq/en/uk/ru) goes in through the existing supplies importer, dry run first, then ?apply=1; a recipe skeleton per menu dish is proposed from its name, grams empty until the owner types them, and only complete dishes go through the recipes importer. Stable ids (pack-*): a second run updates, never duplicates.
description.uk: Заповнення складу: стартовий набір суші-кухні та чернетки техкарт з меню, через наявні імпортери, спершу перевірка, потім застосування.

producer.what: turn(): the CSV judged against the catalogue; the extra columns clean_pm, cook_pm, pack, pack_qty read by bulk/extras.rs and applied through supplies::check + record

consumer.what: open(): step 1 posts suppliesCsv (start-stock-logic.js), step 2 posts recipesCsv of the READY drafts

transport.why: the dishes and their bom, for the skeletons

request_schema.description: A CSV. Supplies: header id,name,unit,kind,category,kcal,protein,fat,carbs,weight_per_unit,clean_pm,cook_pm,pack,pack_qty. Recipes: header dish,ingredient,qty with qty as '<whole number> <g|ml|unit>'.

probe: node tools/live-proof/probes/stock-start.mjs (main runs it on qa-durres after deploy)
